bagPolicy.summary: At UVM athletics events, clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. UVM students may not bring backpacks.
allowed: Clear plastic bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
prohibited: Bags that are not clear or larger than allowed
Food and beverages of any kind
bagPolicy.note: No storage or check-in area is provided for items not allowed inside. The fan guide is written for UVM Athletics events, so a concert can set its own rules.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Patrick Gym can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Patrick Gym. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Concession service is available for many UVM Athletics events, but locations, menus, and payment options vary. Review the current fan guide and event information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Patrick Gym, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Patrick Gym's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For Catamount basketball games, ticket windows are in the Patrick Gymnasium lobby and open 1 hour before game time, which is also when will call pickup starts there. Earlier will call pickup is at the Vermont Ticket Office on the balcony above the lobby, and ID is recommended. Tickets bought online are delivered digitally. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Patrick Gym. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
